Class ExchangeController

java.lang.Object
edu.ntnu.idi.idatt2003.millions.controller.ExchangeController
public class ExchangeController extends Object
Controller that mediates between the view and the Exchange / Player model.

      public BigDecimal getUnitSalePrice(Transaction transaction, BigDecimal qty)
      Returns the effective unit sale price for a transaction. For purchases this is the purchase price; for sales it is gross ÷ quantity.

      qty - the quantity sold/bought
      Returns:

    • findStocks

      public List<Stock> findStocks(String keyword, BigDecimal minPrice, BigDecimal maxPrice)
      Searches for stocks by keyword and optional price bounds. Null bounds mean no limit. Inverted bounds are normalised internally.
      Parameters:
      keyword - the search term
      minPrice - minimum price inclusive, or null
      maxPrice - maximum price inclusive, or null
      Returns:
      matching stocks
